$comment: The Borrowed Board in the Loggia (docs/specs/ISLAND-06-inkwell-bluffs.md §5.1): the guild’s notice (Open in Copilot app, the install dialogs), the roll (Customize, Installed, Plugins), the bell (Restart canvas extensions), the board’s frame (Add tab, Canvas, Repository Issues Kanban), and its cards (one card to Plan; it comes back on Ready). The places, lamps and the card on the board are the game’s; every word is this file’s.

notice.name: The guild’s notice
notice.means: **Open in Copilot app**, and the two install dialogs

card.name: The board’s cards
card.means: Issues you drag between columns: **Plan**, then **Ready**

text.title: The Borrowed Board
text.intro: Take the guild’s board in, find it on the roll, ring the bell, hang the board, and move one card.

laps.title: The Borrowed Board: try a community canvas

stations.title: Install the plugin
stations.prompt: You selected **Open in Copilot app**, then **Allow**. The **Install plugin** dialog is open. What do you do?

options.text: Confirm that the name is `accessibility-kanban@awesome-copilot`, then select **Install**
options.result: The crate’s stencil matches the notice. It goes in.

options.text: Select **Install** at once: the page sent me here
options.reason: Confirm that the name is `accessibility-kanban@awesome-copilot` first.

options.text: It’s blocked here, so I change my organization’s settings
options.reason: Enterprise-managed settings can restrict which plugins are available. If you cannot install the plugin, read Exercise 1 and continue to Exercise 2.

hints: What did you learn about plugins on Sunspire?
Read the name in the dialog.

stations.title: Confirm that it’s installed
stations.prompt: Where do you confirm that the plugin is installed and on?

options.text: **Customize**, then the **Installed** tab: it appears under **Plugins**, with its toggle on
options.result: It’s on the roll, with its toggle on.

options.text: In the review panel: the board is open already
options.reason: Not yet. The session has not reloaded its canvas extensions.
That lists changed files. A plugin is not a file in this repository.

stations.title: Reload the extensions
stations.prompt: Back in your session, the new canvas isn’t offered yet. What do you submit?

options.result: The bell rings. The extensions reload, and the new one is picked up.

options.reason: That reloads skills. For a canvas, submit the prompt `Restart canvas extensions`.

options.text: Nothing: install the plugin a second time
options.reason: It is installed. This reloads the extensions and picks up the newly installed one.

hints: What does the bell’s plate say?

stations.title: Open the canvas
stations.caption: The **+** menu, with **Canvas** open.
stations.prompt: In the review panel you select **+** (**Add tab**), then **Canvas**. Which entry do you select?

options.result: The board hangs in its frame, and loads the issues from the current repository.

options.text: I look for `accessibility-kanban`, and stop when it is not there
options.reason: `accessibility-kanban` is the package name, not the name that the app shows.

options.text: There’s no review panel, so I give up
options.reason: If the review panel is hidden, select **View** > **Toggle Panel** first.

hints: Two names: one on the crate, one on the board.
The app shows the board’s own name.

stations.title: Move a card
stations.prompt: The board loads the issues and organizes them by status. How many cards do you drag to **Plan**?

options.result: One card on **Plan**, and a runner goes out with it.

options.text: All of them, to get every plan at once
options.reason: Each card that you move to **Plan** starts a new agent run, so move only one card there.

options.text: None: I ask for the plan in chat
options.reason: Moving the card is how this board asks the agent. The canvas keeps state visible without scrolling through chat.

hints: What does each card on **Plan** start?

stations.title: Watch it come back
stations.prompt: The canvas asks the agent to plan that issue in a background agent.
stations.text: The agent reads the issue and the code, but does not edit files. When the plan is ready, the card moves to **Ready**. You moved it once, and the agent moved it again.
